cause_quote: The desktop action key began hashing `.update(JSON.stringify([stableScope, stableCallId, COMPUTER_ACT_COMMAND]))`, so distinct assistant responses in the same run produced the same key when the provider reused a call ID.
user_saw: Later Code Mode calls or computer actions could fail with idempotency conflicts when the provider reused a tool call ID across assistant responses.
summary: The fix includes assistant response identity in nested Code Mode call IDs and desktop and mobile action keys while keeping replays of the same call stable.
reasoning: I verified that the parent already dispatched desktop actions with a fresh `crypto.randomUUID()` per invocation, so repeated provider IDs could not cause this conflict. PR #103422 replaced those random keys with a run-scoped hash and added node receipts that rejected the same key with different parameters. The fix also covers independent origins in the same failure pattern: PR #132457 added the attempt-scoped transcript key that made reused nested IDs collide, and PR #112255 introduced mobile actions with a run-and-call-scoped key.
